summary: UI colour-group updater. Selects one of three colour groups on this via a2 (1/2/3), converts the byte RGB inputs a3-a5 to floats by scaling with 0.0039215689 and a per-group alpha factor, writes the three components into the group's float fields, then pushes the group through DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup using the cached vertex-buffer identifier at this+4. Finally sets the 0x800 dirty bit on the UI context at dword_8B8F28+236 and returns that context pointer.

local_names.this: UI colour object holding three float colour groups and the vertex-buffer identifier
local_names.v6: cached vertex-buffer identifier read from this+4 (case 2)
local_names.v7: DirectX texture-coordinate slot selector (2 for group 1, 4 for group 3)

operations.description: Switch on a2 to choose the active colour group: case 1 targets floats this+8/+12/+16 with scale factor this+20; case 2 targets this+24/+28/+32 with scale this+36; case 3 targets this+40/+44/+48 with scale this+52
Case 1: write the three colour components at this+8/+12/+16 from a3/a4/a5, each scaled by 0.0039215689 and the group alpha factor at this+20; stage DirectX slot selector v7 = 2

Case 2: read the vertex-buffer identifier into v6 from this+4, write the three colour components at this+24/+28/+32 scaled by 0.0039215689 and the group alpha factor at this+36, then call DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup with slot selector 3
Case 3: write the three colour components at this+40/+44/+48 scaled by 0.0039215689 and the group alpha factor at this+52; stage DirectX slot selector v7 = 4
Push the colour group to the vertex buffer via DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup(dword_8B78A0, this, *(this+4), v7); cases 1 and 3 share this call, case 2 issues its own with selector 3
Set the 0x800 dirty bit on the UI context: *(dword_8B8F28 + 236) |= 0x800
Return the UI context pointer dword_8B8F28; called by ByteExtractionFromUint (0x0055D3F0)
